content.body:
I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

Omar, scaling Freshworks across the Middle East & Africa means your team in Dubai is under constant pressure to ship the right features fast — and in a cost-optimization market, slow feedback loops become a direct tax on roadmap precision.

Teams using real-time customer signals and A/B testing infrastructure cut their feedback cycles significantly, ensuring roadmap decisions are grounded in what users actually adopt — not what the team assumes.

We're an AWS Advanced Tier Partner with 6+ years of partnership and have built scalable data lakehouse architectures integrating Salesforce and other source systems for enterprise clients — directly relevant to Freshworks' AWS-heavy stack.

Worth a focused 20-minute call this week to explore whether this fits where your MENA product motion is headed?
